issue.title: First-class sase monitors on the Admin Center Procs tab
issue.description: A monitor proc is unmistakable on the Procs tab: it wears the orange monitor gear, streams its live output like the agent metadata panel does, names the sase agent it belongs to, and opens that agent on the Agents tab with <enter> — while the tab header reports running plain procs and running monitors as blue and orange gear counts.

issue.title: Observer carries the monitor's log path and agent name
issue.description: observer-monitor-fields: carry log_path and shell_name on ObservedProc and read a proc's tail from its own log path, so artifacts-owned monitor logs stream instead of reading empty.

issue.title: Monitor rows wear the gear and name their agent
issue.description: monitor-row-presentation: mark monitor rows with the orange gear in the list and output header, show the monitor's agent name, and render durable tails through the shared cached ANSI renderer.

issue.title: Blue and orange gear counts in the tab header
issue.description: header-gear-counts: extract the top-bar gear chip into a shared helper and render scope-aware running plain-proc and monitor counts in the Procs tab title.

issue.title: <enter> opens the monitor's agent on the Agents tab
issue.description: agent-jump: add the <enter> keymap that resolves a monitor row to its agent and reveals it on the Agents tab, with honest failure messages and help/hints coverage.

issue.title: Documentation and visual snapshot suite
issue.description: docs-and-visual-suite: rewrite the Procs Tab documentation for monitor rows, counts, and the jump key, then rebaseline and extend the Procs PNG goldens.
